newsitem.title: USA: Court approves Anchor Glass sale pact.
newsitem.headline: Court approves Anchor Glass sale pact.

text.p: Anchor Glass Container Corp, a unit of Mexico's Vitro SA, said on Friday that U.S. Bankruptcy Court approved the agreement to sell Anchor's assets to Consumers Packaging Inc and a unit of Owens-Illinois Inc for $392.5 million and the assumption of certain liabilities.
The agreement was approved by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Wilmington, Delaware, subject to submission of the final order approving the sale, Anchor said.
The Consumers and Owens offer provides for $333.6 million in cash and $58.9 million in preferred and common equity securities of a new entity to be formed by Consumers, the Anchor said.
The deal is subject to regulatory approvals, the closing of previously executed financing commitments and other conditions, and is expected to close by the middle of January 1997, Anchor said.
In September 1996, Anchor filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy and later entered a deal to sell its assets to Ball-Foster Glass Container LLC, Anchor said.
Anchor received the Consumers and Owens bid on December 2, 1996, and announced on December 12, 1996 that it would support their offer as a higher and better bid.
